parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
),
my_cards AS (
  SELECT card_id, card_type, last4, status
  FROM cards
  WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM c)
),
target AS (
  SELECT * FROM my_cards
  WHERE ($3 <> '' AND (last4 = $3 OR card_type = $3))
     OR ($3 = '' AND status IN ('blocked', 'lost', 'expired')
         AND (SELECT count(*) FROM my_cards WHERE status IN ('blocked', 'lost', 'expired')) = 1)
),
existing AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.delivery, r.fee, r.created_at
  FROM card_replacements r
  JOIN target t ON t.card_id = r.old_card_id
  WHERE r.status = 'requested'
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO card_replacements (old_card_id, customer_id, delivery, fee)
  SELECT t.card_id, (SELECT customer_id FROM c), $4,
         CASE WHEN $4 = 'express' AND t.status <> 'blocked' THEN 25 ELSE 0 END
  FROM target t
  WHERE t.status IN ('blocked', 'lost', 'expired')
    AND $4 IN ('standard', 'express')
    AND $5 = 'yes'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id, old_card_id, customer_id, delivery, fee, created_at
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO card_actions (card_id, customer_id, action, reason, details)
  SELECT old_card_id, customer_id, 'replacement_requested', delivery, 'fee ' || fee
  FROM inserted
  RETURNING id
),
fee_charged AS (
  INSERT INTO transactions (txn_id, account_id, txn_time, description, category, amount, channel, status)
  SELECT 'TR' || lpad(i.id::text, 6, '0'), a.account_id, now(),
         'Express card delivery fee', 'fees', -i.fee, 'fee', 'pending'
  FROM inserted i
  JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = i.customer_id AND a.account_type = 'checking'
  WHERE i.fee > 0
  RETURNING txn_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT customer_id FROM c) AS customer_id,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('type', card_type, 'last4', last4, 'status', status)), '[]'::json) FROM my_cards) AS all_cards,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('type', card_type, 'last4', last4, 'status', status)), '[]'::json) FROM target) AS target,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('delivery', delivery, 'fee', fee, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) FROM existing) AS existing,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'delivery', delivery, 'fee', fee, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) FROM inserted) AS inserted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fee_charged) AS fee_charged;
